channel.title: The Dig — Spin qubit devices and figures of merit
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Spin qubit devices and figures of merit preset. Today's ranked reading list centers on three high-relevance papers: 2611.27140 on FPGA-in-loop autonomous tuning of spin qubits, 2611.27927 on transpilation-aware multi-vendor QPU scheduling, and 2611.29983 on a calibration-aware quantum software stack. The remaining skims cover verified Hamiltonian-simulation compilation (2611.28388), semiclassical clustering for spin-ensemble decoherence (2611.28958), higher-order Trotter-Suzuki schemes (2611.27896), a binary-tree QAOA decomposition for Max k-Cut (2611.30508), and a learned small-circuit mitigation wrapper (2611.28261).
